title: Ask Then Build
goal: Builders who plan don't break things. Think first. Ask. Then do.
mascot_lines: Before we build anything, it helps to ask one good question first.
A clear question saves us tons of time later.
So we plan a tiny bit, then build a tiny bit, then check.
Ask, build, check — that's the secret rhythm of great coders.
